study_type: Controlled reanalysis and consensus post-processing of released citation-checker decisions
primary_rule: flag if at least 3 of 5 tools flag
primary_success_rule: Majority reduces false-positive rate by at least 0.10 absolute versus RefChecker while retaining recall of at least 0.80 on this frozen corpus.
lodo_selection: For each held-out source document, select k from 1..5 by maximum mean per-training-document balanced accuracy; exact ties choose the smaller k. Remove normalized-reference duplicates of held-out references from training. Apply the selected k once to the held-out document.
ablation: Remove each tool in turn; use strict majority of the four remaining tools (at least 3 flags). This changes panel size as well as membership and is a sensitivity test, not a causal attribution.

bootstrap.scheme: Paired row resampling within each source document, maintaining observed document sample sizes
bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional descriptive reference-level uncertainty within three observed documents; not an interval for generalization to unseen documents

data_rule: All five tool flags must be present and valid; missing or unknown values cause an explicit error and are never silently treated as acceptance.
novelty_claim: None. Hard voting is established. The contribution is a reproducible controlled evaluation, source-held-out threshold selection, and error/workload analysis on this released corpus.
resource_limit: CPU-only tabular processing; no model downloads, local model inference, paid APIs, or participant recruitment.
changes_rule: Keep this protocol file unchanged after freezing. Record any later analytical change in protocol_amendments.md, with timing and whether outcomes had been seen.
